Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. This Court passed the following order dated 10-4-2019 in WPC No.1369 of 2019 :
4. In view of the submission made before this Court, the demarcation of the land of the petitioner qua the layout of road whether it through or over the land of the petitioner may be carried out.

If any portion of the land is enveloped for construction of road, the Municipal Corporation shall resort to land acquisition proceeding under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that subsequently the demarcation was carried out by the Patwari, PH No.15 on 28-5-2019 wherein khasra No.928 about 2100 sq.ft.
was reported to be comprised and used for the road and despite that no proceeding for acquisition has been started.

4. At this juncture, learned counsel appearing for the respondent would submit that the statutory demarcation was carried out by the Tahsildar under the orders of the Collector and the subsequent demarcation report dated 5-12-2022 (Annexure - D/2) would show that khasra No.928 is not effected for construction of road.

sentences.text: Since there is a conflicting in demarcation reports, therefore, in this contempt petition this Court cannot consider the correctness of the demarcation reports, as two conflicting demarcation reports are on record.
The admissibility of the correctness of the same is required to be adjudicated before the appropriate forum.
So, in fact, no willful disobedience of the order of this Court is made out.
6. In view of the above, the petitioner would be at liberty to avail the remedy as may be available to her under the provisions of law.
7. Accordingly, the contempt petition is disposed of and the Rule is discharged.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Since there is a conflicting in demarcation reports, therefore, in this contempt petition this Court cannot consider the correctness of the demarcation reports, as two conflicting demarcation reports are on record.
The admissibility of the correctness of the same is required to be adjudicated before the appropriate forum.
So, in fact, no willful disobedience of the order of this Court is made out.
